scope_change_reason: The suggested R439 H2/K helper-star boundary has extensive predecessor and current overlap. This scope tests a different complete local boundary: one arbitrary source row is borrowed, reconfigured through three target parities, and restored after a closed Gray tour. It is not a general H2/K replacement theorem.

original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: For arbitrary binary rows A,B,C and three arbitrary targets in each of the AB, ABC, and AC parity classes, implement the exact target map with one borrowed source row following 00->10->11->01->00 and restoring its arbitrary boundary value.
bottleneck_link: A proven row-add saving can reduce a bit mechanism only if a source-pinned supplier word contains these parity classes at one compatible frame; no such occurrence or selected-profile effect is known.
stop_rule: Stop after exact transfer-matrix equality, exhaustive 2^12 one-bit arbitrary-dirty replay, four meaningful negative controls, the charged 21-versus-13 row-add profile, and the one-anchor tour bound. Do not claim a supplier or kappa result without a pinned caller.
evidence: verify.py certifies the 12-row map and reverse schedule, checks all 4096 scalar input states, enumerates the six mask visitation orders, and rejects four boundary mutations. EXPECTED.json records the exact receipt; PROOF.md gives the identity and cost argument.
